The supplied pages do not support the requested requirement for at least 15 purchasable upgrades; an upgrade kit would require explicit design decisions and should not be presented as canon.
The selected record omits later manga material appearing in the abilities page, including references to volumes and chapters after the end of Wano, such as chapter 1081 and volume 115.

The abilities page mixes manga, anime, non-canon, and video-game material. Video-game-only techniques such as Medicine, Strong Medicine, Absolute Rest, Cure, Operation, Emergency Case, and Keep Out are excluded from the selected manga record.
